question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**from**" indicates the source or origin of something. (से)
 
• In the context of the passage,** "information from 443 peer-reviewed studies"** means the information was obtained from those studies.
 
• The other options: "**with**," "**by**," and "**below**" do not convey the correct meaning of sourcing information in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *To better understand how native and non-native species respond to extreme weather events, the scientists behind the new study reanalysed information from__ 443 peer-reviewed studies on how species responded to wildfires, droughts and other conditions.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **With (के साथ)**: used to indicate accompaniment.
 
• **By (द्वारा)**: used to indicate the agent or means, but not suitable here.
 
• **Below (नीचे)**: used to indicate a lower position.
